style.name: Minimalism
style.description: Minimalist interfaces reduce visual elements to what supports the content and task. Careful typography, spacing, and proportion carry the identity when decoration is kept restrained.

fonts.heading: DM Sans
fonts.rationale: A single versatile family supports a clear hierarchy without introducing unnecessary visual voices.

tips: Keep useful labels and interaction cues.
Use one accent color with a clear role.
avoid: Equating empty space with good hierarchy.
Making controls visually indistinguishable from text.

recipe.composition: Reduce to essential content and clear affordances; give spacing and typography explicit roles.
recipe.motion: Prefer immediate navigation and subtle state feedback; avoid ornamental reveals.
recipe.signature: Few decisions, expressed consistently, with generous space and clear purpose.
